speaker: Ms Yeo Wan Ling (Pasir Ris-Punggol)
text: Indeed, my Punggol residents have often given the feedback on the crowded trains and they are frustrated when they are unable to get on the trains. especially in the mornings when they need to get to work and school on time.

speaker: Ms Yeo Wan Ling (Pasir Ris-Punggol)
text: In fact, parents have told me that their kids are sometimes left behind on the platforms as they cannot get onto the crowded trains.

speaker: Ms Yeo Wan Ling (Pasir Ris-Punggol)
text: How would LTA and the Ministry ensure that passengers can enjoy smooth and convenient transitions between the use of the LRT and the increased interim bus services?

speaker: Ms Yeo Wan Ling (Pasir Ris-Punggol)
text: I think our residents would want to make sure that the travel times as well as trips are done in a convenient and safe way, especially for the school children.

speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
text: Indeed, I think we do need to make sure that the transport system as a whole, the different parts of it, work well together.

speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
text: Because from a commuter's point of view, you take bus and LRT, and you may switch to the trains for the longer part of the journey.

speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
text: One useful tool which I will encourage commuters to use, especially those who are more familiar with technology, is to download and use the transport app.

speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
text: That will show the possible journey options and also, which is the path that will give you the quickest way to get to your destination and also what are the connecting options available.

speaker: Mr Gan Thiam Poh (Ang Mo Kio)
text: I just want to ask the Senior Minister of State whether there will be additional dual-trains for Sengkang LRT stations, as requested by my residents.
